description: WatchDogsGo — WiFi/BLE/LoRa/SDR wardriving RPG, ported to the CardputerZero

store.summary: Watch Dogs-style hacking game with real WiFi/BLE/LoRa/SDR tooling
store.description: An open-world hacking RPG that overlays real WiFi/BLE/LoRa/SDR security tooling on a retro pyxel HUD. Wardrive with the device's own WiFi/BLE radio or an ESP32, track GPS position on a live map, run LoRa/MeshCore mesh networking off a Cap LoRa module, and pick up ADS-B/433 MHz traffic with an RTL-SDR dongle — all wrapped in a Watch Dogs-style world map, XP, and badge progression. Ported from the ClockworkPi uConsole original (github.com/LOCOSP/WatchDogsGo) to run as an installed app on the CardputerZero's own launcher. Still in beta: see the project README for current status.
